'''HybridHunter Hidden Hunters''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[HybridHunter]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Vile HybridHunter DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A capture deck full of mandalorian goodness.

== Strategy ==

No real stratagy just get hunters out and pray for one with mand armor or mand armor its self.  After that jedi are a little less dangerous with hidden weapons.  If all else fails just sit back and drain with Moseop and Gailid.

It's not much but it works.
